雅思 5.5 / 托福 46 / PTE 42，2 年内有效: IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 46 / PTE 42, valid within 2 years
胸部 X 光，移民局指定体检机构: Chest X-ray at a panel physician approved by the immigration service
全年境外医疗保险保单: Overseas medical insurance policy for the full year
白底电子证件照: Digital ID photo with a white background
往返机票或购票资金证明: Return ticket or proof of funds to buy one
语言成绩、学历公证、存款证明、保险必须提前办好。抢名额当天无法临时补交材料，材料: Language results, notarised qualifications, bank certificates and insurance must all be arranged in advance. Nothing can be supplied later on the day places open; incomplete documents mean the application fails.
注册 Immigration New Zealand 账号: Create an Immigration New Zealand account
提前在官网注册账号并熟悉申请流程，开放前测试网络环境。建议使用 Chrome 浏: Register on the official site ahead of time and learn the process; test your connection before places open. Chrome is recommended, and log in early.
开放当天抢名额: Secure a place on opening day
在新西兰时间指定开放时刻（通常为 7 月初某日上午 10:00）登录在线系统，填: Log in to the online system at the published New Zealand time, usually 10:00 on a day in early July, complete the form and submit. With only 1,000 places and many applicants the site is likely to be congested, the process takes a long time and connection speed matters. A place is secured only when every step is finished and payment succeeds.
缴纳签证费并等待确认信: Pay the visa fee and wait for the confirmation letter
支付 NZD 670 审理费 + NZD 100 入境旅游税，共约 NZD 77: Pay the NZD 670 processing fee plus the NZD 100 visitor levy, about NZD 770 in total. Visa, MasterCard or UnionPay credit and debit cards are accepted. A confirmation letter arrives by email with instructions on the documents to submit.
收到确认信后，15 天内递交体检材料，60 天内将其他证明材料扫描件发送到指定邮: After the confirmation letter, submit the medical within 15 days and email scans of the remaining evidence to the address given within 60 days. No postal delivery is needed.
等待审理并获签: Wait for the decision and receive the visa
审理周期约 2-6 周。获批后必须在签证签发之日起 12 个月内入境新西兰。入境: Processing takes about 2–6 weeks. Once approved you must enter New Zealand within 12 months of the visa being issued; the 12-month stay only starts counting from entry.
名额仅 1,000 个，先到先得，历史上一经开放即在 10-30 分钟内抢完。需: Only 1,000 places, first come first served, and they have historically gone within 10–30 minutes of opening. It demands thorough preparation and a solid connection.
一生只能申请一次。错过或失败即永久失去该机会，无二次申请可能。: Once in a lifetime. Missing it or failing means losing the chance for good, with no second attempt.
抢名额当天网络极易拥堵，流程耗时长。建议提前登录、提前测试网络、使用有线网络。: The site is easily congested on opening day and the process is slow. Log in early, test your connection beforehand and use a wired network.
签证费不退。若因材料问题被拒，费用不予退还。: The visa fee is non-refundable, including when an application is refused over documents.
常见工作类型：农业采摘、农场工作、服务业（餐厅/咖啡店/酒店）、旅游业、滑雪场。: Common work: agricultural picking, farm work, services (restaurants, cafés, hotels), tourism and ski fields. Avoiding big cities such as Auckland makes work easier to find.
可为同一雇主工作不超过 6 个月。学习或培训总计最多 6 个月。持有效签证期间可: You may work for one employer for up to 6 months and study or train for up to 6 months in total. You can leave and re-enter New Zealand multiple times while the visa is valid.
不可续签。但若在葡萄栽培或园艺行业完成 3 个月季节性工作，有机会额外获得 3: Not renewable. However, completing 3 months of seasonal work in viticulture or horticulture can open the door to an extra 3 months.
英国与部分国家和地区签订的青年流动计划，允许 18-30 岁（部分 18-35: A youth mobility scheme between the UK and selected countries and territories, letting people aged 18–30 (18–35 for some) live and work in the UK for 24 months. ⚠️ Mainland China is not a YMS partner, so its passport holders cannot apply under this route. Hong Kong and Taiwan are on the list.
YMS 不要求提供英语考试成绩: YMS does not require an English test result
需在申请前连续持有 28 天以上: Must be held continuously for at least 28 days before applying
约 2,530 英镑资金证明（用于支付初期生活费用）: Proof of about GBP 2,530 to cover initial living costs
中国台湾 1,000 个/年、中国香港有独立配额；中国大陆不在名单内，无配额。: Taiwan 1,000 places a year, Hong Kong has a separate quota; mainland China is not on the list and has no quota.
YMS 采用抽签制，每年分批开放。中国大陆无法申请。: YMS uses a ballot, opening in batches each year. Mainland China cannot apply.
按年计，2 年约 GBP 1,552: Charged yearly, about GBP 1,552 for 2 years
约 2,530 英镑，连续持有 28 天以上: About GBP 2,530, held continuously for at least 28 days
在签证申请中心采集: Collected at a visa application centre
英国 YMS 仅对签约国家/地区开放。中国大陆不在名单内。若持中国大陆护照，此项: UK YMS opens only to partner countries and territories. Mainland China is not on the list, so its passport holders cannot apply.
等待抽签开放并注册: Wait for the ballot to open and register
（仅限合格护照持有人）YMS 对高需求地区采用抽签制或配额制，须在开放时提交申请: (Eligible passport holders only) For high-demand territories YMS uses a ballot or quota, and you must apply when it opens.
（仅限合格护照持有人）在线递交申请，缴纳签证费、IHS 及生物识别费。: (Eligible passport holders only) Apply online and pay the visa fee, the IHS and the biometric fee.
中国台湾、中国香港护照持有者可申请。若用户持中国大陆护照但符合港澳台身份，需按对: Taiwan and Hong Kong passport holders may apply. If you hold a mainland Chinese passport but also qualify under a Hong Kong, Macao or Taiwan identity, apply under that passport's rules.
可为任意雇主工作，无需雇主担保。可自雇（部分限制）。: You may work for any employer without sponsorship and may be self-employed, within limits.
不可续签，不可转为其他签证类别在英境内。: Not renewable, and you cannot switch to another visa category from inside the UK.
美国国务院官方文化交流项目，允许全球全日制在校大学生持 J-1 签证暑期赴美进行: An official US Department of State cultural exchange programme letting full-time university students worldwide spend 8–16 weeks in paid summer work in the US on a J-1 visa, with a maximum stay of 4 months. It is the only overseas paid programme with no quota, aimed at enrolled students, and with no hard language threshold. Mainland Chinese students must apply through a designated sponsor and a domestic partner agency.
U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Educ: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs
通常要求 18-28 周岁的全日制在校本科生、研究生。具体上限以各 Sponso: Usually full-time undergraduates and postgraduates aged 18–28. The exact upper limit is set by each sponsor.
必须是美国境外经认证的大专院校全日制在读学生，且已完成至少 1 个学期或同等时长: You must be enrolled full-time at an accredited institution outside the US and have completed at least 1 semester, or the equivalent, of post-secondary study. Any field qualifies.
无需雅思/托福成绩，但必须具备足以在英语工作环境中沟通的能力。须通过项目方英语测: No IELTS or TOEFL needed, but you must be able to communicate in an English-speaking workplace. You pass the programme's English test and the US employer's interview.
无官方资金门槛。但由于需要自付项目费、机票、前期食宿，须具备一定经济基础。实习薪: No official funds threshold, but you pay the programme fee, flights and initial accommodation yourself, so some financial buffer is needed. The wages usually cover living costs in the US.
无年度名额上限。全球每年约 10 万名大学生参加。但单个 Sponsor 机构的: No annual quota. About 100,000 students worldwide take part each year, but each sponsor has a limited number of placements, so apply early.
2026 年暑期项目报名已于 2025 年底至 2026 年初完成。工作时间通常: Registration for summer 2026 closed between late 2025 and early 2026. Work usually runs from mid-June to mid-September.
2027 年暑期项目报名自 2026 年秋季起由各 Sponsor 机构陆续开放: Registration for summer 2027 opens with individual sponsors from autumn 2026. The State Department's BridgeUSA page sets no single deadline; each sponsor sets its own registration and placement calendar. Placements go first come first served, so complete sponsor registration in autumn or winter 2026 and start matching early.
各机构不同，部分机构在通过英语测试后可退: Varies by sponsor; some refund it once you pass the English test
含岗位匹配、DS-2019 表、SEVIS I-901 费、签证辅导、医疗保险、: Covers placement matching, the DS-2019 form, the SEVIS I-901 fee, visa coaching, medical insurance and pre-departure training
学校出具的全日制在读证明: Full-time enrolment certificate issued by your school
证明 6-9 月为学校假期，需提前向院系申请: Showing that June to September is your school holiday; request it from your department in advance
报名前须征得家长/监护人同意: Parent or guardian consent is required before registering
美国国务院授权 Sponsor 机构签发的核心文件，项目方协助办理: The core document issued by a State Department-authorised sponsor; the programme handles it for you
通常含在项目费中: Usually included in the programme fee
美方雇主工作邀请函，通过雇主面试后获得: The US employer's offer letter, received after passing the employer interview
咨询报名与英语测试: Enquire, register and take the English test
了解项目详情，提交报名表，缴纳报名费，签订项目参与协议。参加线上英语能力测试，7: Learn the programme details, submit the registration form, pay the registration fee and sign the participation agreement. Take the online English test and pay the programme fee balance within 7 working days.
填写美方申请文件，根据可用工作时间、英语水平和个人意愿匹配岗位。参加美方雇主线上: Complete the US application documents and get matched on availability, English level and preference. Attend the employer's online or in-person interview; some sponsors provide interview coaching.
获得 Job Offer 与 DS-2019 表: Receive the job offer and DS-2019 form
通过雇主面试后获得 Job Offer，缴纳项目费尾款，由 Sponsor 机构: After passing the interview you receive the job offer, pay the programme fee balance, and the sponsor issues the DS-2019, the core document for the J-1 visa.
缴纳 SEVIS 费并预约面签: Pay the SEVIS fee and book the interview
缴纳 SEVIS I-901 费，填写 DS-160 表，预约美国使领馆 J-1: Pay the SEVIS I-901 fee, complete the DS-160 and book a J-1 interview at a US mission. Attend the visa coaching session.
赴美使领馆面签: Attend the interview at the US mission
按预约时间前往美国使领馆参加面签。J-1 签证通过率相对较高。: Attend at the appointed time. J-1 approval rates are relatively high.
签证通过后购买往返机票，参加行前培训（美国企业文化、项目规范、跨文化适应、法律安: After approval, book return flights and attend pre-departure training covering US workplace culture, programme rules, cultural adaptation, legal and safety matters and emergency contacts.
赴美实习与旅行: Work and travel in the US
入境美国后办理社会安全号（SSN），入住上岗。工作结束后享有最长 30 天合法旅: Apply for a Social Security number (SSN) after arrival, then start work. A lawful travel period of up to 30 days follows the job. You must return home by the programme end date.
回国销签与退税: Close the visa and claim the tax refund at home
回国后返校报到，提交登机牌办理销签。于回国次年按美国税务机关要求提交材料办理退税: Report back to your school on return and submit your boarding pass to close the visa. File the tax refund the following year as the US tax authority requires.
必须通过美国国务院授权 Sponsor 及国内中介机构申请，无法自主申请。中介质: You must apply through a State Department-authorised sponsor and a domestic agency; independent application is not possible. Agency quality varies widely, and some are shell operations.
历史上存在系统性问题：房租被中介指定且高于当地市场 2-3 倍；岗位差、工资低；: There have been systemic problems: housing assigned by the agency at 2–3 times local market rent; poor placements and low pay; and programme fees that include flights for some nationalities but not for mainland Chinese students.
岗位安置后不得任意更改实习起止时间，否则将导致岗位取消、丧失赴美机会。: Once placed you cannot change the start or end dates freely; doing so cancels the placement and forfeits the trip.
J-1 身份与特定雇主绑定，若擅自辞职另找工作，在美留居身份将变为非法，人身安全: J-1 status is tied to a specific employer. Quitting to find other work makes your stay unlawful, with no legal protection for your safety or rights.
美国国务院 BridgeUSA 官方页面未设统一报名截止日期，亦不公布统一截止时: The State Department's BridgeUSA page sets no single deadline and publishes no common cut-off; each sponsor's registration window and placement calendar differ. Claims that you must register before a given month usually come from agencies; rely on the sponsor's own notices.
优势：不限名额、无语言硬门槛、门槛低；J-1 签证记录对未来赴美留学签证有正向参: Strengths: no quota, no hard language threshold and a low entry bar; a J-1 record helps future US study visa applications. Wages cover basic costs in the US.
岗位均为非专业性基础服务类，每周工作 32-40 小时，超时按州法支付加班费。: Placements are non-professional entry-level service roles, 32–40 hours a week, with overtime paid under state law.
可多次参加该项目（须每次满足在校生身份要求）。: You can take part more than once, as long as you meet the enrolment requirement each time.
销售需自行购入存货的岗位: Sales roles where you must buy the inventory yourself
私人住宅内的家政工作（育儿、养老、园艺、司机）: Domestic work in private homes (childcare, elder care, gardening, driving)
任何需驾驶执照的车辆或船只操作: Operating any vehicle or vessel that requires a licence
涉及患者接触的临床护理岗位: Clinical care roles involving patient contact
